##### Project general facts

Ellison by Nshama Group is a contemporary residential development in the vibrant community of Town Square Dubai, designed to offer a balanced lifestyle where urban convenience meets green open spaces. Ideally located at the entrance to the main park, the project presents a collection of elegant one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as spacious three-bedroom duplexes. With modern architecture, expansive windows, private balconies, and bright contemporary interiors, each residence is thoughtfully designed to maximize comfort, functionality, and natural light while capturing attractive boulevard and park-facing views.

Residents enjoy a wide range of family-oriented amenities that enhance everyday living and foster a strong sense of community. The development features dedicated swimming pools, children’s play areas, and fully equipped fitness facilities, creating an environment that supports relaxation, recreation, and an active lifestyle for all ages. Positioned within one of Dubai’s most established master-planned communities, Ellison also benefits from seamless access to Town Square’s parks, retail, dining, and leisure offerings.

Each residence is finished with high-quality contemporary materials that reflect the project’s clean and modern design language. The apartments include kitchens equipped with German-made appliances and are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners the flexibility to personalize their interiors while enjoying a well-appointed and thoughtfully designed living space.

##### Location description and benefits

Town Square Dubai is a vibrant and expansive mega-development located in the heart of Dubai. At the core of Town Square Dubai is the picturesque Town Square Park, which serves as the central hub for residents and visitors alike. The park features lush green spaces, jogging tracks, and play areas, providing a refreshing escape from the urban hustle and creating a sense of unity and community spirit.

Town Square Dubai boasts a host of exceptional facilities and amenities, making it a vibrant and dynamic place to live. Residents can enjoy access to sports courts, fitness centers, swimming pools, as well as retail and dining outlets within the community. A Town Square Mall, with a variety of shops and entertainment options, further enriches the living experience.

The development's strategic location provides easy connectivity to major highways, ensuring convenient access to other parts of Dubai. Additionally, Town Square Dubai is within proximity to schools, hospitals, and other essential services, offering residents a well-connected and comprehensive lifestyle.
